item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem: Meera fixes a straight stick upright in her school playground in Jaipur and marks the tip of its shadow every few minutes. She wants to measure the length of one day, which is nearly 24 hours. Which observation should she use?

options.A: The time between the stick casting its longest shadow on two successive days
options.B: The time between the shortest shadow of the stick on one day and the shortest shadow on the next day
options.C: The time from sunrise to sunset on a single day
options.D: The time between the stick first casting a shadow in the morning on two successive days
